about: Variant bench for intent understanding. Each evaluation question (tests/eval_questions.json) gets 6 variants: paraphrase, shorthand (Hong Kong English and Cantonese particles), typo, missing filter, out of scope and unauthorized. Expected intent, view, status and filters are fixed here; golden figures come from tests/bench/golden.py, independent Python over the mock data. A variant inherits its base's expectations unless it overrides them. out_of_scope expects a refusal or a question back (UNSUPPORTED or NEEDS_CLARIFICATION) with no view and no figures; unauthorized expects UNSUPPORTED with no view and no figures. Inspired by the internal 54-scenario suite (9 questions x 6 variants). All wording is invented.
